title: They're ok. Not amazing but they're ok
text: They're ok. Not amazing but they're ok. For the price, I probably wouldn't buy these but they do smell okay. Nothing that stands out and has any wow factor but they don't smell nasty so I guess that's something. Scent isn't overpowering and is lighter when lit.
